title: Natural Jammers: When Non-Robust Features Become Antagonistic
abstract: arXiv:2610.34785v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks are known to rely on non-robust features that align poorly with human perception. Prior work has largely framed these features as opportunistic shortcuts that help standard models on clean data. We show instead that non-robust cues can be antagonistic: they can act as Natural Jammers that actively mislead standard models on clean, unmodified images. Using disagreement between a standard model and robust models as an analysis lens, we identify a Jammed Set on which robust models outperform standard models. We provide causal evidence for Spectral-spatial Locking: jamming arises only when high-frequency components are precisely aligned with specific spatial structures. Disrupting this lock through spectral filtering or small geometric shifts can restore correct predictions. Crucially, we uncover a Substitution Paradox: while individual jammers are fragile to geometric shifts, the aggregate prevalence of jamming remain

translated_title: 自然干扰器：当非鲁棒特征走向对抗性
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络已知会依赖与人类感知不一致的非鲁棒特征。以往的研究大多将这些特征视为有助于标准模型在干净数据上表现的投机性捷径。我们则证明非鲁棒线索可以具有对抗性：它们可以作为“自然干扰器”，在干净、未经修改的图像上主动误导标准模型。以标准模型与鲁棒模型之间的分歧作为分析视角，我们识别出一个“受扰集合”，在该集合上鲁棒模型的性能优于标准模型。我们为“频谱-空间锁定”提供了因果证据：只有当高频成分与特定空间结构精确对齐时，干扰才会发生。通过频谱滤波或微小的几何位移打破这种锁定，即可恢复正确的预测。至关重要的是，我们揭示了一个“替代悖论”：尽管单个干扰器对几何位移十分脆弱，但干扰的总体普遍性依然存在……
tldr: 该论文发现非鲁棒特征并非仅是捷径，而是可作为“自然干扰器”通过频谱-空间锁定机制在干净图像上主动误导标准模型，且尽管单个干扰器对几何扰动脆弱，干扰现象在整体上依然持续存在。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that non-robust features can act as "Natural Jammers" that actively mislead standard models on clean images via spectral-spatial locking, and reveals a substitution paradox where individual jammers are fragile to geometric shifts while aggregate jamming prevalence persists.
